items.original: Emsculpt NEO pairs radiofrequency heating with HIFEM contractions in a single 30-minute session — reducing fat and building muscle simultaneously across the abs, glutes, biceps, triceps, thighs, calves and flanks (love handles).

items.original: RF energy warms the tissue to break down fat cells while HIFEM energy triggers thousands of supramaximal contractions in the muscle beneath — the equivalent of a workout your body can't do on its own. Two results from one applicator, and it's the most-requested body treatment across our lounges.
